name: Complete Contact Information Form
description: Step-by-step guide for filling out a Google Forms contact information form with proper validation and submission
instructions: Open Chrome browser
Click the plus (+) icon at the top of the browser window next to the rightmost tab to open a new tab
Click on the address bar
Type 'docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSenTSf_Mcih3pMCmfrD1LZdOb0VbSg3qUlyld2F8VjCeasskA/viewform' and press Enter
Wait for the form to load completely
Note the form heading 'Contact information' at the top
Look for fields marked with a red asterisk (*) as these are required
Click on the first field labeled 'Name *'
Type 'John Smith' in the 'Name' field
Press Tab to move to the 'Email *' field
Type 'johnsmith@example.com' in the email field
Press Tab to move to the 'Address *' field
Type '123 Main Street, Anytown, CA 94502' in the address field
Press Tab to move to the 'Phone number' field (note: this field is not marked as required)
Enter '555-123-4567' in the phone number field
Press Tab to move to the 'Comments' field
Enter 'This is a test submission for the contact form. Please disregard.' in the comments field
Review all entered information for accuracy
Click the 'Submit' button at the bottom of the form
If you need to start over, click the 'Clear form' link next to the Submit button
After successful submission, check for a confirmation page
Note the warning at the bottom: 'Never submit passwords through Google Forms'
